title: Fire: What to do
summary: How to escape a home fire safely: get out fast, stay low under the smoke, check doors for heat before opening, and never go back inside for belongings.
steps: Get out immediately — do not stop to collect belongings.
Stay low under smoke; cleaner air is near the floor.
Before opening a door, touch it with the back of your hand. If hot, use your planned alternative exit.
Close doors behind you as you leave to slow the spread of fire and smoke.
Once out, stay out and call for help from outside.
If your clothes catch fire: STOP, DROP, and ROLL, covering your face with your hands.
avoid: Do not use elevators during a fire.
Do not throw water on an electrical or grease (cooking oil) fire.
Do not stand upright in smoke — smoke rises; stay low and crawl to an exit.
Do not go back inside for belongings once you are out.
